main_text.p: iubentur:iumenta itidem & diuersi gene-ris animalia compulsa fame ac siti,lamen-tantiumGen.4. speciem cum hominibus præbe-bant. Ita imminens malum auersum. longe [?] apud Deum conquerenti, quod fides di-ctis non affuisset, responsum:pœnitenti-bus veniā negari non posse. At in Sama-ria Zachariam regem admodum impium, quem superius regnasse memoravimus, Sella{a}Sella quidam interemit,regnumque oc-cupavit:idemque Manæ insidiis, exemplo facti fui, periit. Mane {b}ereptum Sellæ im-perium tenuit, filioque Phacea{c}Pache reliquit. Eundem vero {d}Pache quidam ejusdē no-minis interemit, regnumque occupavit. 4.Reg.15Mox ab Ofee peremptus, eodem scelere, quo assumpserat, imperium amisit. Hic ultra omnes reges superiores impius, poenam sibi perpetuamq; genti captivita-tem a Deo meruit. Namq; ei Salmanasar rex Asyriorum intulit bellum, victumq; tributarium sibi effecit. Sed cum occul-tis consiliis rebellionem pararet, regem-que Aethiopum, qui tum Aegyptum obtinebat, in auxilium accerferet, idque Salmanasar comperisset, perpetuis eum vinculis in carcerem conjecit,urbemq; ex-cidit,

page.notes: Marginal notes, left: "Gen.4." beside "tantium"; "a Sella" beside "Sella"; "b Manes pro Manè aut Manahem." beside "facti fui"; "c Phacea" beside "minis"; "d Phacee" beside "Mox ab" [Phacee reading doubtful]; "4.Reg.15" beside "Eundem"; "Vide nō-tas" beside "tributarium"; "4.Reg.17. 4." beside "obtinebat". Notes b, c and d were placed in the text by their marks, not in full. The margin note under "b" reads "Manes pro Manè aut Ma-nahem." (not transcribed in full in the paragraph because it stands in the margin beside "facti fui"). The page number "18" at the top left is partly unclear. "longe" is uncertain (printed "longè" or similar). The marginal notes were not all placed in full; please check against the margin.
